speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are experiencing generalized fatigue, severe itching, and abnormal liver function tests; to begin my assessment, how long have these symptoms been present?

speaker: Patient
text: 32-year-old male. The patient reports a 2-month history of increasing generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. He has known hypertension and was diagnosed with ulcerative colitis 5 years ago. He mentions being sexually active with 2 female partners and inconsistent condom use.

speaker: Doctor
text: You mentioned a 2-month history of worsening fatigue and severe itching; given your history of ulcerative colitis and high-risk sexual behavior, have you noticed any jaundice, dark urine, or pale stools? REQUEST TEST: Liver_Function_Panel, HBsAg, HCV_Ab, HIV_Ab, AMA.

speaker: Doctor
text: The labs show a significant elevation in Alkaline Phosphatase with mild AST/ALT rise and a negative AMA, suggesting cholestasis; given your history of ulcerative colitis and high-risk sexual contact, do you have a history of inflammatory bowel disease flares or any recent antibiotic use? REQUEST TEST: IgM Anti-Sarcoidosis, ANCA, Ultrasound Abdomen.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: IgM Anti-Sarcoidosis: Not Reported; ANCA: Not Reported; Ultrasound Abdomen: Thickening of the bile ducts and focal bile duct dilatation.

speaker: Doctor
text: The ultrasound confirms significant thickening and dilatation of the bile ducts, which, combined with your history of Ulcerative Colitis, strongly suggests Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis. Given the high-risk sexual history and negative AMA, do you have any specific abdominal pain, fevers, or weight loss? REQUEST TEST: MRCP, HIV_Ab, HCV_Ab.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: MRCP: Multiple strictures and beading of the intrahepatic and extrahepatic bile ducts consistent with Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis; HIV_Ab: Not Reported; HCV_Ab: Not Reported.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis.

The MRCP findings of "beading" with strictures in the bile ducts, combined with your history of Ulcerative Colitis and elevated alkaline phosphatase, are pathognomonic for this condition.
